description: This file defines the CampaignTracker class, which extends SugarBean and manages data related to campaign tracking in the SuiteCRM project. It includes properties mapping to database fields, methods for saving data, generating summaries, and filling in additional details, as well as handling URL schemes for tracking links.

classes.name: CampaignTracker
classes.description: Represents a campaign tracker in SuiteCRM, containing properties for tracking data and methods to manipulate and retrieve campaign tracking information.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides the save method to ensure the tracker URL has a proper scheme before saving.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the tracker name as summary text for display purposes.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional details such as campaign name and message URL based on related data and admin settings.
